  • Classes in com.leap.leaplaughlove.common.market used by com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.portfolio
    Class
    Description
    MarketClock
    Tells every service which market session is in force, from MarketCalendar and the market.hours.* settings. common is outside each app's component scan, so an app that needs it imports it, as with JwtService.
    MarketSession
    The US equity market's trading sessions, in US Eastern time: pre-market 4:00-9:30, regular 9:30-16:00 (13:00 on early-close days), after-hours until 20:00 (17:00 on early-close days), and closed overnight, at weekends and on exchange holidays.
